notes.title: Just cracked open the box. Kōbako is live. 🟥
notes.notes:
[p][b]Kōbako (コウバコ)[/b] is a tiny indie game studio in a little red box. [/p][p]We restore files from an anonymous message board thread in a small town called Akabako (赤箱, “Red Box”) a place where rumors, regrets, and strange things keep surfacing.[/p][p][/p][p]Each thread begins the same: [/p][p]A post. A username.[/p][p]Sometimes there's an attachment. [/p][p]That’s what we restore. [/p][p][/p][p]Every Kōbako game is one of those attachments.
[/p][p][/p][p]More soon,[/p][p]Kōbako [/p]
